_comment: Eight stereo Float32 frames the way a stereo mixdown process tap delivers them (48 kHz, 2 channels, Float32, kAudioTapPropertyFormat flags 9 = float | packed, interleaved L R, as read live on an M5 Pro). Values are powers of two so every gain in 'gains' multiplies exactly. 'expectedMono' is (L + R) / 2 per frame, a mono output at gain 1.
